keyVerseDR: "The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few." (Mt 9:37)

level1.title: Jesus Sends Helpers
level1.story: Jesus saw the crowds were like lost sheep. He chose 12 Apostles to help Him. He sent them to heal and to share His love.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How many helpers did Jesus choose?
level1.prayer: Jesus, make me Your helper. Amen.

activity.title: The Apostles' symbols
activity.intro: Peter has keys, Andrew a cross, James a shell. Color and draw!
activity.prompt: St Peter with the keys, St Andrew with his X-shaped cross, St James with a shell

level2.title: The Twelve Are Sent
level2.story: Jesus saw the crowds and felt sorry for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. He said, "The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few." Jesus called His twelve Apostles, Peter and Andrew, James and John, and the others. He gave them power to cure every disease. He sent them out saying, "Without cost you have received; without cost you are to give."
level2.keyLine: The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Can you name some of the Twelve?
How can you be a 'laborer' now?
actions: Learn the names of the Apostles
level2.prayer: Lord of the harvest, send laborers. Amen.

activity.title: Saints and their symbols
activity.intro: Match each Apostle to his symbol.

art.mainBrief: Jesus sending the Twelve; wheat field ready for harvest
